# IconSearch — Comprehensive Developer & LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)

> IconSearch (https://iconsearch.info) is the independent vector discovery engine, design suite, and API service indexing 355,702 free SVG icons across 229 open-source libraries.

Primary URL: https://iconsearch.info
API Base URL: https://iconsearch.info/api
Documentation: https://iconsearch.info/docs/agents
Last Updated: August 2026

---

## 1. Table of Contents

1. Overview & System Capabilities
2. All 18 Primary Icon Libraries (Complete Technical Specs)
3. Public REST API Reference & Parameter Schemas
4. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Definitions for AI Agents
5. Multi-Framework Code Integration Patterns
6. Export Formats & Customization Engine
7. Licensing, Legal Verification & Non-Affiliation Disclaimers

## 2. Overview & System Capabilities

IconSearch provides search, in-browser customization, programmatic vector generation, and direct component exporting for frontend developers and AI agents (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Roo Code, ChatGPT).

- Total Index Size: 355,702 SVG vector icons
- Commercial-Safe Index: 259,070 royalty-free icons (MIT, Apache 2.0, ISC, CC0, OFL)
- Primary Curated Libraries: 18 named collections
- Total Open Source Collections: 229 Iconify-backed icon sets
- Framework Support: React, Next.js (App Router / RSC), Vue 3, Svelte 5, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- Export Capabilities: Clean SVG, React TSX, Vue SFC, Svelte 5 component, Tailwind inline SVG, PNG (16px–1024px), WebP, ICO, and ZIP packages.

---

## 3. All 18 Primary Icon Libraries

### 1. Lucide Icons (`lucide-icons`)
- **Total Icons**: 1,960+
- **License**: ISC (Permissive open source, 100% commercial-safe, no attribution required)
- **Design Specifications**: 24x24 grid, 2px stroke width, consistent optical balance
- **Framework Packages**:
  - React / Next.js: `npm install lucide-react`
  - Vue 3: `npm install lucide-vue-next`
  - Svelte 5: `npm install lucide-svelte`
  - Vanilla JS: `npm install lucide`
- **TypeScript**: Native `.d.ts` declaration files included
- **Server Components**: 100% RSC-compatible, zero client-side JavaScript overhead
- **Official Links**: GitHub (https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide), Docs (https://lucide.dev)

### 2. Heroicons (`heroicons`)
- **Total Icons**: 324
- **License**: MIT (Permissive open source by Tailwind Labs)
- **Design Specifications**: 24x24 outline (1.5px stroke), 24x24 solid, 20x20 mini, 16x16 micro
- **Framework Packages**:
  - React / Next.js: `npm install @heroicons/react`
  - Vue 3: `npm install @heroicons/vue`
- **Tailwind Integration**: Native pairing with Tailwind UI components and utility classes
- **Official Links**: GitHub (https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons), Docs (https://heroicons.com)

### 3. Tabler Icons (`tabler-icons`)
- **Total Icons**: 6,147
- **License**: MIT (Created by Paweł Kuna)
- **Design Specifications**: 24x24 grid, 2px stroke width, massive variety for dashboards
- **Framework Packages**:
  - React / Next.js: `npm install @tabler/icons-react`
  - Vue 3: `npm install @tabler/icons-vue`
  - Svelte: `npm install @tabler/icons-svelte`
- **Official Links**: GitHub (https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons), Docs (https://tabler.io/icons)

### 4. Phosphor Icons (`phosphor-icons`)
- **Total Icons**: 1,533
- **License**: MIT (Flexible icon family created by Tobias Fried & Helena Zhang)
- **Design Specifications**: Six visual weights: Thin, Light, Regular, Bold, Fill, and Duotone
- **Framework Packages**:
  - React: `npm install @phosphor-icons/react`
  - Vue: `npm install @phosphor-icons/vue`
- **Official Links**: GitHub (https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core), Docs (https://phosphoricons.com)

### 5. Radix Icons (`radix-icons`)

## 4. Public REST API Reference

### Base URL
`https://iconsearch.info/api`

### Rate Limits
- Public requests: 120 requests / minute per IP
- No API key required for public search and raw SVG retrieval.

### Endpoint 1: Search Icons (`GET /api/icon-search`)
Query parameters:
- `q` (string, optional): Search keyword (e.g. `arrow`, `user`, `settings`, `chart`, `cloud`).
- `lib` (string, optional): Library slug filter (e.g. `lucide-icons`, `heroicons`, `tabler-icons`, `radix-icons`, or `iconify`).
- `iconifySet` (string, optional): Specific Iconify collection ID when `lib=iconify` (e.g. `material-symbols`, `carbon`).
- `style` (string, optional): Style filter: `all`, `stroke`, `solid`, `duotone`, `twotone`, `sharp`.
- `legalOnly` (number, default: `1`): `1` returns only commercial-friendly licenses; `0` returns all licenses.
- `sort` (string, default: `relevance`): `relevance`, `popular`, or `name`.
- `page` (number, default: `1`): Pagination page number.
- `limit` (number, default: `60`, max: `120`): Number of icons per page.
- `ids` (string, optional): Comma-separated icon IDs for batch lookup (up to 200).

Response Schema:
```json
{
  "icons": [
    {
      "id": "lucide-icons-arrow-right",
      "name": "arrow-right",
      "displayName": "Arrow Right",
      "library": "lucide-icons",
      "libraryName": "Lucide Icons",
      "license": "ISC",
      "tags": ["arrow", "forward", "next", "right"],
      "svgUrl": "/api/svg/lucide-icons/arrow-right"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1420,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 60,
  "totalPages": 24
}
```

### Endpoint 2: Raw SVG Endpoint (`GET /api/svg/[library]/[iconName]`)
- URL: `https://iconsearch.info/api/svg/:library/:iconName`
- Example: `https://iconsearch.info/api/svg/lucide-icons/check`
- Returns: Clean, optimized XML SVG string with `Content-Type: image/svg+xml`.

---

## 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Definitions

For integration with Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, and custom LLM agent systems:

### Tool 1: `search_icons`
- **Description**: Search 355,000+ open-source vector SVG icons by keyword, library, and style.
- **Parameters**:
  - `query` (string, required): Keyword describing the desired icon (e.g. "shopping cart", "user profile", "warning triangle").
  - `library` (string, optional): Target icon library slug (e.g. "lucide-icons", "heroicons", "tabler-icons").
  - `style` (string, optional): "stroke", "solid", or "all".
  - `limit` (number, optional, default: 10): Max number of results to return.

### Tool 2: `get_icon_svg`
- **Description**: Retrieve the raw SVG code for a specific icon by library slug and icon name.
- **Parameters**:
  - `library` (string, required): Library slug (e.g. "lucide-icons").
  - `name` (string, required): Icon identifier (e.g. "arrow-right").
  - `color` (string, optional): Hex color or "currentColor" (default: "currentColor").
  - `size` (number, optional): Pixel dimension width and height (default: 24).
  - `strokeWidth` (number, optional): Stroke width in pixels (default: 2).

### Tool 3: `get_icon_component`
- **Description**: Generate a ready-to-use framework component snippet (React TSX, Vue 3, Svelte 5, or Tailwind SVG).
- **Parameters**:
  - `library` (string, required): Library slug.
  - `name` (string, required): Icon identifier.
  - `framework` (string, required): "react", "nextjs", "vue", "svelte", or "tailwind".
  - `typescript` (boolean, optional, default: true): Generate TypeScript code.

---

## 6. Multi-Framework Code Integration Patterns

### React & Next.js 15 App Router (Server Component — Zero Client JS)
```tsx
// app/components/Header.tsx
import { Search, ShoppingBag, User } from 'lucide-react'

export default function Header() {
  return (
    <header className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-zinc-900 border-b border-zinc-800">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Search className="size-5 text-zinc-400" />
        <input type="text" placeholder="Search..." className="bg-transparent text-sm text-zinc-100" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <button aria-label="Cart">
          <ShoppingBag className="size-5 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white transition-colors" />
        </button>
        <button aria-label="Profile">
          <User className="size-5 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white transition-colors" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>
  )
}
```

### Vue 3 Composition API (`<script setup>`)
```vue
<!-- components/Navigation.vue -->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Home, Settings, Bell } from 'lucide-vue-next'
</script>

<template>
  <nav class="flex items-center gap-4">
    <Home :size="20" class="text-zinc-300 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors" />
    <Settings :size="20" class="text-zinc-300 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors" />
    <Bell :size="20" class="text-zinc-300 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors" />
  </nav>
</template>
```

### Svelte 5 with Runes
```svelte
<!-- src/lib/FavoriteButton.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
  import { Heart } from 'lucide-svelte'
  let active = $state(false)
</script>

<button onclick={() => active = !active} class="p-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900">
  <Heart size={20} class={active ? 'text-rose-500 fill-rose-500' : 'text-zinc-400'} />
</button>
```

### Tailwind CSS v4 Utility Styling
```html
<!-- Responsive micro-animated icon button -->
<button class="group flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition">
  <span>Explore Features</span>
  <svg class="size-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13.5 4.5L21 12m0 0l-7.5 7.5M21 12H3" />
  </svg>
</button>
```

### Strictly Typed TypeScript Polymorphic Icon Wrapper
```tsx
// components/ui/icon.tsx
import React from 'react'
import type { LucideIcon, LucideProps } from 'lucide-react'

export interface IconProps extends Omit<LucideProps, 'ref'> {
  icon: LucideIcon
  label?: string
  className?: string
}

export function AppIcon({ icon: Icon, label, className = '', size = 20, ...rest }: IconProps) {
  return (
    <Icon
      size={size}
      className={className}
      aria-hidden={!label}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : 'presentation'}
      {...rest}
    />
  )
}
```
